limits: Daily figures only, no hourly or 5-minute data.
The last 90 days only, ending yesterday.
No Northern Territory, which has no public market data.
WA means the WEM, which covers the south-west only (not the Pilbara or remote WA).
Output is by region and fuel, not per power station. Stations have capacity only.
No forecasts, only what already happened.
rules_md:
# Energy business rules (NEM + WEM, via Open Electricity)

## Networks and regions
- Two separate markets, NOT interconnected — `network` says which:
  - NEM: five regions NSW1 | QLD1 | SA1 | TAS1 | VIC1 (state-scale zones).
  - WEM: one region, WEM — the South West Interconnected System of WA
    (Perth and the south-west only; not the Pilbara or remote WA).
- "The NEM" means `network = 'NEM'` — always filter it; never let WEM rows
  into NEM totals or averages. "Australia", "national", "all markets" means
  both, reported per network. Northern Territory is not covered.
- Always qualify which region (and, when both appear, which network) a
  number belongs to.

## Units
- Energy MWh (additive — sum it). Power MW and demand MW are daily-average
  rates — average, never sum. Prices AUD/MWh (a rate — average only, can go
  negative). NEM and WEM prices come from different market designs: show
  them side by side, never average across the two networks. Emissions
  tCO2e (additive). Market value AUD (additive).

## Renewable definition (governed)
- Renewable = `is_renewable` in fueltech_groups (wind/solar/hydro/bioenergy).
  Batteries and pumps STORE energy; they are not generation. Never enumerate
  techs in SQL — join the mapping table or use the renewable_share cube.

## Fuel families (governed)
- "Coal", "gas", "solar", "wind", "hydro", "battery" mean a fueltech_group
  from the fueltech_groups mapping, never a hand-picked list of fueltech
  values: coal = coal_black AND coal_brown (Victoria burns brown coal),
  gas = five gas techs, solar = utility + rooftop + thermal. Filter
  `fueltech_group = 'coal'` via the mapping (join on fueltech).

## Batteries
- Battery `energy_mwh` goes NEGATIVE when charging. This is correct NEM
  behaviour, not dirty data. Do not filter negatives out.

## Statuses
- facilities.status: operating | committed | commissioning | retired.
  Commissioning units report <=90% of capacity. Capacity questions SUM
  capacity_registered_mw; output questions belong to generation_daily.

## Grain and window
- Daily grain, market-local calendar days (NEM AEST +10, WEM AWST +08 —
  the same date covers different hours), 90-day rolling window ending
  yesterday. `facilities` is unit grain (site columns carried).
- No facility-level output table exists yet: capacity-vs-output questions
  need two queries (capacity from facilities, output from generation_daily).

## Canonical joins
- generation_daily → fueltech_groups on fueltech; facilities →
  fueltech_groups on fueltech; generation_daily → market_daily on
  network_region + day.

topics.name: Prices & demand
topics.summary: Daily wholesale spot prices and electricity demand, per region.
limits: Prices are averaged, never summed. NEM and WA prices come from different market designs, so they are compared side by side, never averaged together.

examples.question: What was the average spot price by region over the last 30 days?
Which region had the cheapest average spot price over the last 7 days?
On the highest-price day in the last 30 days, which fuel types generated the most?
examples.sql:
WITH spike AS (
  SELECT day, network_region, price_aud_mwh
  FROM market_daily
  WHERE day >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30' DAY
  ORDER BY price_aud_mwh DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT g.fueltech, SUM(g.energy_mwh) AS energy_mwh
FROM generation_daily AS g
JOIN spike AS s
  ON g.network_region = s.network_region AND g.day = s.day
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2 DESC

examples.question: Which region used the most electricity over the last 30 days?

topics.name: Generation & fuel mix
topics.summary: How much electricity each fuel type produced, per region and day, and what it was worth at spot prices.
limits: Battery rows go negative when charging. That is correct, not bad data.

examples.question: Which fuel types generated the most in Queensland over the last 7 days?
How much electricity did wind generate across the NEM over the last 7 days?
How much did rooftop solar generate in each region over the last 30 days?
What share of NEM generation came from coal over the last 30 days?

topics.name: Emissions
topics.summary: Tonnes of CO2-equivalent emitted per region, fuel and day, plus each generating unit's emissions factor.

examples.question: Which region had the highest emissions over the last 7 days?
Which fuel types emitted the most in Victoria over the last 30 days?
Which region had the lowest emissions per MWh generated over the last 30 days?
Which operating generating units have the highest emissions factor?

topics.name: Renewables
topics.summary: Renewable share of generation, using the governed definition (wind, solar, hydro and bioenergy; batteries excluded).
limits: Renewable follows the governed is_renewable flag. Storage (batteries, pumps) is never counted as generation.

examples.question: What share of NSW generation was renewable over the last 30 days?
examples.sql:
SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN is_renewable THEN energy_mwh ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(energy_mwh), 0) AS renewable_pct
FROM generation_with_group
WHERE network_region = 'NSW1' AND day >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30' DAY

examples.question: How does WA's renewable share compare with each NEM region over the last 30 days?
How did South Australia's daily renewable share change over the last 30 days?
On which day in the last 90 days was the NEM's renewable share highest?

topics.name: Power stations & capacity
topics.summary: Every registered generating unit with its location, fuel, status and capacity in MW.
limits: Capacity is registered MW, not output. Commissioning units may run below full capacity.

examples.question: Show me operating coal capacity by state.
examples.sql:
SELECT f.network, f.network_region, SUM(f.capacity_registered_mw) AS coal_mw, COUNT(DISTINCT f.facility_code) AS sites
FROM facilities AS f
JOIN fueltech_groups AS g ON f.fueltech = g.fueltech
WHERE f.status = 'operating' AND g.fueltech_group = 'coal'
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 3 DESC

examples.question: Which are the 15 largest operating wind and solar facilities by registered capacity?
How much new capacity is committed or commissioning, by fuel group?
Which are the 10 largest operating batteries by storage capacity?

cubes.name: daily_generation
cubes.description: Daily generation output (NEM regions + WEM), emissions, and market value by region and fuel tech. Gross energy, MWh — battery rows can be negative (charging). Pair with renewable_share for the clean share.

cubes.name: daily_price
cubes.description: Daily spot price (NEM regions + WEM) (AUD/MWh, averaged — never summed) and additive demand energy by region. Join generation for fuel-mix-during-price-events questions.

cubes.name: renewable_share
cubes.description: Renewable vs total daily generation by region. renewable_share_pct is the governed share (percent, ratio of sums over whatever window and grouping you query) — use it, never divide yourself. Renewable follows the governed is_renewable flag (wind/solar/hydro/bioenergy; batteries excluded).

measures.name: renewable_energy
measures.expression: SUM(CASE WHEN is_renewable THEN energy_mwh ELSE 0 END)

measures.name: renewable_share_pct
measures.expression: 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN is_renewable THEN energy_mwh ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(energy_mwh), 0)

views.name: generation_with_group
views.description: Daily generation pre-joined to the governed fuel grouping. Grain: one row per region x fueltech x day (network carried); use as the base for renewable-share aggregation (avoids re-declaring the mapping).

columns.name: day
columns.description: Market-local calendar day (midnight): NEM days are AEST (+10), WEM days AWST (+08). 90-day rolling window.

columns.name: network
columns.description: Market: NEM (east-coast grid, five regions) | WEM (south-west WA, one region). Separate, unconnected markets — filter network = 'NEM' when the user says 'the NEM'.

columns.name: network_region
columns.description: Market region: NSW1|QLD1|SA1|TAS1|VIC1 (network NEM) or WEM (network WEM, south-west WA).

columns.name: fueltech
columns.description: Fuel technology. Joins to fueltech_groups.fueltech for group + renewable flag — never hardcode which techs are renewable.

columns.name: fueltech_group
columns.description: Coarse group: coal|gas|hydro|wind|solar|battery|fossil|renewable|other.

columns.name: is_renewable
columns.description: THE governed renewable flag. Wind/solar/hydro/bioenergy only — batteries and pumps store energy, they do not generate it. Never redefine renewable in SQL.

columns.name: energy_mwh
columns.description: MWh generated that day. Battery rows go NEGATIVE when charging (load exceeds discharge) — this is correct, not dirty data.

columns.name: emissions_tco2e
columns.description: Tonnes CO2e emitted that day. Null/zero for non-emitting tech.

columns.name: market_value_aud
columns.description: AUD value of that day's output at spot prices.

models.name: facilities
models.description: Generation registry (NEM + WEM) at unit grain. Capacity questions SUM capacity_registered_mw; output questions belong to generation_daily — this table holds no output.

columns.name: facility_code
columns.description: Site identifier (e.g. a power station). One site has many units — COUNT(DISTINCT facility_code) for site counts.

columns.name: facility_name
columns.description: Display name of the site.

columns.name: network_region
columns.description: Market region: NSW1|QLD1|SA1|TAS1|VIC1 (network NEM, state-scale zones) or WEM (network WEM, south-west WA).

columns.name: network
columns.description: Market: NEM (east-coast grid, five regions) | WEM (south-west WA, one region). Separate, unconnected markets — filter network = 'NEM' when the user says 'the NEM'.

columns.name: unit_code
columns.description: Generator identifier. Grain: one row per UNIT, not per site.

columns.name: fueltech
columns.description: Unit fuel technology (coal_black|wind|solar_utility|battery|...). Joins to fueltech_groups.fueltech for group + renewable flag.

columns.name: status
columns.description: Unit status: operating|committed|commissioning|retired. Commissioning units report <=90% of capacity — they are not full output.

columns.name: capacity_registered_mw
columns.description: Registered capacity in MW. SUM this for capacity questions — never output.

columns.name: capacity_maximum_mw
columns.description: Maximum achievable capacity in MW.

columns.name: capacity_storage_mwh
columns.description: Storage capacity in MWh. Only batteries and pumped hydro have values.

columns.name: emissions_factor_tco2e_mwh
columns.description: Tonnes CO2e per MWh. Null for non-emitting tech (wind, solar).

columns.name: latitude
columns.description: Site latitude (WGS84). Site-level — every unit of a site shares it. Null for a few sites.

columns.name: longitude
columns.description: Site longitude (WGS84). Site-level — every unit of a site shares it. Null for a few sites.

models.name: fueltech_groups
models.description: Static 29-row mapping. The single source of truth for 'what counts as renewable' — join it, don't enumerate techs.

columns.name: fueltech
columns.description: Fuel technology identifier, matches generation_daily.fueltech and facilities.fueltech.

columns.name: fueltech_group
columns.description: Coarse group: coal|gas|hydro|wind|solar|battery|fossil|renewable|other.

columns.name: is_renewable
columns.description: THE governed renewable flag. Wind/solar/hydro/bioenergy only — batteries and pumps store energy, they do not generate it. Never redefine renewable in SQL.

models.name: generation_daily
models.description: Daily generation by network, region and fuel tech (NEM + WEM). Grain: one row per region x fueltech x day. For market context join market_daily on region + day.

columns.name: day
columns.description: Market-local calendar day (midnight): NEM days are AEST (+10), WEM days AWST (+08). 90-day rolling window.

columns.name: network_region
columns.description: Market region: NSW1|QLD1|SA1|TAS1|VIC1 (network NEM) or WEM (network WEM, south-west WA).

columns.name: network

columns.name: fueltech

columns.name: energy_mwh

columns.name: emissions_tco2e
columns.description: Tonnes CO2e emitted that day. Null/zero for non-emitting tech.

columns.name: market_value_aud
columns.description: AUD value of that day's output at spot prices.

models.name: market_daily
models.description: Daily market outcomes by network and region (NEM + WEM). Grain: one row per region x day. Join generation_daily on region + day for fuel-mix-during-price-events questions.

columns.name: day
columns.description: Market-local calendar day (midnight): NEM days are AEST (+10), WEM days AWST (+08). 90-day rolling window.

columns.name: network_region
columns.description: Market region: NSW1|QLD1|SA1|TAS1|VIC1 (network NEM) or WEM (network WEM, south-west WA).

columns.name: network
columns.description: Market: NEM (east-coast grid, five regions) | WEM (south-west WA, one region). Separate, unconnected markets — filter network = 'NEM' when the user says 'the NEM'.

columns.name: price_aud_mwh
columns.description: Volume-weighted average spot price that day, AUD/MWh. A rate — average it, never sum it. Can go negative. NEM and WEM prices come from different market designs: compare them side by side, never average across networks.
